text:
My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to build a huge fort in the living room. We used blankets and chairs and it looked like a cave. I got the scissors to cut some tape for the door. Then the whole thing fell down and trapped us inside!

"This is a total failure," Ben said sadly.

I laughed and used my strength to push the blankets off. We landed on the soft rug and started giggling.

"We can fix it," I told him. "I will guide you."

We built it again and pretended we were in a meadow. We were dreaming about fighting dragons until my mom came in. She swept the floor and made us popcorn. It meant we could stay up late and tell scary stories.

My homework was simply a mountain of trouble. It was just math but it felt like danger. I grasped my pencil hard and stared at the paper.

"This is going to be a total failure," I grumbled loudly.

My big brother walked in and he heard me. He is taking psychology in high school so he thinks he is smart.

"Just climb the mountain one step at a time," he said.

I knew he was trying to say something important. I immediately started the first problem at the beginning. I often get caught on the hard ones. But this time I did not stop. I guarantee I finished it fast! School is easier when you just start.

My brother Tim and I went boating down the spooky river. The water was gray and the wind made a moaning noise. We were looking for the magic fountain. It was very important because it could make us fly.

Suddenly, we heard something sounding like a monster! Tim started pumping his legs hard to make the boat go faster.

"Watch out for that rock!" I yelled loudly.

Tim swerved the boat and we almost crashed. Then we saw a green light. A witch brewed a potion near the fountain. We knew it was dangerous, so we hid behind a bush.

"Let's grab the magic water and run," Tim whispered.

We filled our cups and ran away fast. We were safe!

My brother Tim thinks he is the best at everything. He is growing taller than me, so he usually wins. We were playing soccer in the backyard yesterday. I grabbed the ball and ran fast to the goal.

"You can't score on me!" Tim yelled loudly.

I kicked the ball super hard and it blew past him. It hit the old newspaper on the porch and crushed it.

"Goal!" I screamed and did a funny dance.

Tim crawled under the bushes to get the ball back. He came out bringing a dirty spider on his shirt. He was clinging to the fence because he was scared. I won the game because he ran inside crying. It was the best day ever.

My friends and I found a map in the dirt. It looked old and foreign so we knew it was special. We started loading our backpacks with snacks and flashlights.

"Let's go to the spooky cave!" shouted Billy.

We walked for a long time and heard a strange noise. It sounded like stamping feet. Suddenly a giant green beetle jumped out! I almost crushed it with my boot but I stopped.

"Look out for the bug!" I yelled.

Billy threw a rock and cleared the path for us. We felt like we were trained explorers. We found a treasure chest inside the cave. Our quest was complete and we were so happy. It felt like bungee jumping but way safer. My dad is coaching soccer tonight so I have to go home now.

My brother Tom and I went exploring in the woods. We were looking for a secret cave through the tall grass. The wind blew very hard and it was cold.

"Look at that big rock!" Tom shouted loudly.

We saw a dark hole and walked inside the cave. It was scary but we had strength and were brave. Something chewed on an old stick near the entrance. We saw a painting on the wall of a bear.

Suddenly we heard bumping sounds in the back.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Tom.

We ran out and simply did not stop running. A spider thread got on my face. We were waiting for a monster but it was just a squirrel. It was teaching us not to go in dark caves.

I was walking in the jungle and I saw a robot. It was silver and it had a bright red jewel on its chest. The robot was crushed under a big rock. I felt scared but I wanted to help him. I tried to lift the rock but it was impossible.

"Please help me!" the robot shouted very loudly.

I used my superpower and suddenly I was super strong. I lifted the rock with a single hand. The robot stood up and sang a happy song.

"Thank you for saving me," he said.

He gave me a space newspaper from Mars. It had pictures of aliens throughout the pages. Then he flew away into the sky. I hung the paper on my wall. I never told anyone about my new friend.

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to design a super cool fort in the living room. We brought every blanket and pillow from my bed downstairs.

"This is going to be the best fort ever!" Tim yelled.

We tried to squeeze the big couch cushions together. But something went wrong and the roof fell down on us. It felt impossible to fix it. Then my dad came in to keep us company.

"Do you guys need a needle and thread?" he joked.

He helped us lift the blankets up high like a bungee jump. The pillows flew everywhere when we jumped inside. It was so much fun! We ate popcorn and stayed up way too late.

One day my dog Rex ran into the woods. He disappeared behind a big green bush. I was wearing my blue shoes and I ran fast.

"Rex, come back!" I yelled very loud.

The earth was muddy and my shoes got dirty. I saw Rex digging near a tree. He was groaning and making a funny noise. He was not afraid of the dark woods. I knew he found something special. It was a tiny hole in the ground.

"Look at that," I said to Rex.

Suddenly a small rabbit hopped out. It moved with a fast rhythm. The rabbit ran away and the hole closed up. Rex did not complain at all. The grass grew tall there. We walked home before night was approaching. My mom and her daughter were waiting for us. I was happy we were safe.

I looked at my desk and started groaning. There was a mountain of homework sitting there. My teacher, Mrs. Green, sent us home with fourteen math pages! I felt my worry growing bigger and stronger. Just then, a wind blew through my open window. Papers flew everywhere and scattered all over my floor.

"Oh no!" I yelled loudly. "My homework is everywhere!"

My mom came in and touched my shoulder gently. "We can fix this mess," she said.

We started climbing over toys to get the papers. I discovered one under my bed and another keeping my door open. My heart sank when I saw my dog chewing one. But we taped it up. Finally, it was done. It was hard work, but I finished it all before dinner.

It was Wednesday and I was ready for the big game. My younger brother Timmy wanted to play too. I had to guide him through the jungle level first. He kept getting stuck in a hole.

"Use your super strength!" I yelled at the screen.

Timmy pressed the button and his character jumped high. We escaped the scary pit just in time. Then a dragon flew down and scorched the ground. We almost got roasted by the fire breath!

"Watch out!" Timmy screamed as he dropped his controller.

Our car crashed into a tree but we were okay. I realized we actually won the race anyway. I grinned at Timmy and gave him a high five. My dad walked in and greeted us. He is good at coaching us in video games. We are going to be champions soon.

My dog Buster and I went on an adventure yesterday. We walked to the big woods behind my house. Suddenly I saw a squirrel and Buster started screaming.

"Stop Buster!" I yelled but he didn't listen.

He ran fast and led me deep into the trees. I feared he would get lost forever. Then he stopped near a bush with berries growing on it. Gravity made me trip and I fell on the dirt. I looked up and saw Buster had caught something. It was just an old plastic bag stuck on a branch. I used my scissors from my pocket to cut it free. We spread the bag out on the grass.

"That's enough exploring," I said to Buster.

My mom's daughter was happy to be home safe. Next time I will keep Buster on his leash.

My brother Timmy had a birthday party on Saturday. Mom roasted a big chicken for dinner because it has protein. Timmy dressed up like a cool knight with a plastic sword. He ran around the yard and pretended to fight dragons.

"I am certain I can beat you!" Timmy yelled loudly.

"No way, I am flying and floating!" I shouted back.

We played until my face turned red like a popping vein. Then Mom brought out the cake. I thought it looked so yummy. Timmy tried to explain why he needed the biggest piece. We ate cake and then we watched a movie. It was the best day ever.

Me and my best friend Leo went on a big adventure. We were roaming in the woods behind my house. It looked like a scary jungle. We saw a weird sign on a tree. It had a cool design like a dragon.

"Look at that!" shouted Leo.

"I think it is a treasure map," I said.

We walked deeper into the woods. Suddenly we heard a loud ringing sound. I gripped my stick tight. I trained for this moment. A big dog jumped out! I grabbed a stick and threw it far away. The dog ran after it. We were safe.

We went home and toasted marshmallows. I thought about our fun day.

"Let's go back tomorrow," said Leo.

It was the best day ever.

One day my dog Spot and I went outside to explore. We wanted to find buried treasure in the woods. I pretended to be a brave sailor looking for gold. We walked for a long time and the air felt freezing.

Suddenly Spot stopped and made a moaning sound.

"What is wrong, Spot?" I asked him.

He pushed his nose into a big bush. I was scared but I looked inside. It did not contain gold. It was a tiny kitten sleeping on some leaves! The kitten looked cold so I picked it up.

"We have to help it," I said to Spot.

We dropped our sticks and ran back home fast. My mom gave the kitten some warm milk. We sat by the fire and ate roasted marshmallows. It was better than treasure. We did not learn how to climb trees that day, but we saved a new friend.

My nephew Sam and I went exploring in the woods today. We pretended we were in a big league of explorers. We packed a bag and were loading it with snacks. We walked until the path got all twisted and bumpy. Suddenly, a blue bird flew right past my head!

"Look at that bird!" I shouted loudly.

Sam started stamping his feet on the dirt. He was sounding like a big monster. We walked more and found a tiny island in the creek. We carefully crossed the water on big rocks.

"This is our secret base simply because it is cool," Sam said.

We ate our chips there and felt very brave. It was the best day ever.

My robot friend Zorb had the greatest design ever. He was shiny and green and grasped things easily. One day we found a glowing blue jewel in the park. Suddenly, a big spaceship landed on the grass. An alien came out and looked very mad.

"That is my jewel!" the alien shouted loudly.

"We won it fair and square!" I yelled back.

The alien threw a laser ball at us. Zorb jumped up and caught it. He realized he could use his laser eyes too. They fought together but then the alien left earth. We ate a cookie and did not leave a single crumb. I want to learn more about space now.

My dog Buster loves to play in our big backyard. One day, I heard a loud noise near the bushes. Buster ran over to see what it was. I followed him and discovered a tiny baby bird on the ground. It fell from a great height out of its nest.

"Oh no, poor birdie!" I said to Buster.

Buster sniffed it gently but he didn't touch it. I ran inside and got a soft newspaper for it. Then I saw the mommy bird approaching us fast. She was mad! I threw the paper down and backed away quickly.

"Come on Buster, let's go!" I yelled.

We watched from far away and the mommy bird landed. I felt like I won a prize because the baby was safe. The scenery was nice and sunny. I think gravity is mean for making birds fall down. My dad is coaching my soccer team later, so I told him the story.

It was my birthday last week and I turned eight. My friends came over for a sleepover and we started jumping on my bed. We were loud especially when we played tag. Then my friend Leo tried climbing the tall shelf. He fell down hard and hurt his arm. My mom took him to the hospital fast.

When he came back he had a big white cast. "Does it hurt?" I asked him.

"Only a little bit," Leo said.

We opened my presents later and I got a foreign coin collection. My aunt gave me a shirt but she kept the receipt. I was honest and told her I liked the toys better. Although the party had an accident, it was still fun. I will write Leo a card tomorrow.

One day I found a strange robot in my backyard. He was silver and shiny but he looked broken and sad. I touched his metal arm and he suddenly froze. Then his eyes lit up bright green and he spoke loudly.

"Please help me find my ship," said the robot.

"I can help you search for it," I told him.

We walked through the woods behind my house together. We looked throughout the whole forest for a long time. The robot was very nice and started teaching me alien words. Finally we found a wonderful blue spaceship hidden in the bushes. A small green creature slept inside the ship's big window. The robot was so happy he started swearing in robot language. I didn't understand the words but I knew he was glad. Then he flew away into the sky.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. Max is plain brown and he likes to sniff everything. We walked up a big hill to check the height. Suddenly, Max started barking at a big white sheet.

"Is that a ghost?" I asked Max.

Max just shook his head and kept barking loudly. I was not certain what it was. It looked like it was floating in the air. Then I heard a weird moaning sound. I told Max to listen carefully.

"Maybe the ghost needs caffeine to wake up," I said.

Then the sheet did a big sneeze! It fell down. It was just my brother hiding. A huge black beetle crawled on his shoe. He screamed and ran home fast. Exploring is fun but my brother is silly.

I found a red jewel in the dirt. It was glowing so I put it through a loop of thread. Then I neared the old barn. Suddenly a green alien grew out of the ground! He had three eyes and was swinging a laser.

"Please listen to me!" the alien shouted loudly. "I am hungry for science snacks."

I did not have enough snacks. I blew my whistle for help. A robot colonel flew down from heaven. He was made of shiny metal.

"Stop right there, alien!" said the colonel.

The alien got mad and started swearing in alien language. It sounded like blop-blop-beep. The colonel zapped him and the alien ran away. I was safe.

My brother and I played a new video game yesterday. It was about a big scary castle floating in the sky. My heart was pumping super fast because I wanted to win.

"You have eight lives left," said my brother.

"I know, but the boss is approaching!" I yelled.

Suddenly a giant green monster appeared on the screen. He looked like he was dumping slime everywhere. I used my brain to solve the puzzle quickly. To be honest, I almost fainted when my character fell. But then I realized I had a magic potion. It was like caffeine for my player! I jumped up and hit the monster.

"You won!" my brother screamed.

I was so happy that I did a funny dance. We played again until dinner time.

We played a video game in my apartment last night. It was very important because I wanted to win. My friend Sam came over for company and we ate snacks.

I picked the cool knight character with the big sword. Sam picked the funny green lizard from the island level. We started jumping around and pressing all the buttons fast.

"You stole my power-up!" Sam yelled at the TV.

"No I didn't, I got it first!" I said back.

My hands were trembling because the game was so close. Suddenly, Sam twisted his controller and messed up his move. My knight hit him and won the game! My eyes were stinging because I didn't blink for a long time. Then we were both super hungry so we ate pizza.

My teacher Mrs. Jenkins cleared her throat and looked at me. I sat up straight in my chair because I was nervous. We were learning about a knight who rode a horse. The story was just beginning but then my tummy growled loud. It sounded like an earthquake or a big mountain falling down.

"Did someone bring a lion to school?" asked my friend Billy.
"No, I think my lunch got stole," I whispered back.

Then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside. I froze when I saw the playground because it was huge. We played a game where we were boating on the grass. We crossed the field and pretended to go to the hospital. My friend Sarah was coaching us on how to be doctors. We trained for an hour until the bell rang again. It was the best recess ever.

I woke up early because today was the big soccer game. My dad made breakfast and he drank lots of coffee for caffeine. I packed everything in my bag and walked to the car. The field was far away and looked foreign to me.

"Are you ready to win?" asked my dad, sounding loud.

"Yes, I am going to score!" I said back.

The game started and the ball bounced everywhere. I was breathing hard and running fast. Suddenly the ball landed right at my feet. I kicked it high like it hit the ceiling! It went past the sign that said dangerous. But it went in the goal! It was a pleasant feeling. My coach was happy but the other team was swearing quietly. We won the game and went boating after to celebrate.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We played in the living room of my apartment. Sam was steering his toy car on the rug. Suddenly, the car disappeared under the big green couch. We scrambled to find it on the ground.

"I see a huge black beetle!" Sam called out.

I looked down and it was just a fuzz ball. We laughed and kept looking for his blue car. Finally, I found it inside my mom’s red sweater.

"That is wonderful news," Sam grinned at me.

We decided to do a science experiment with soda next. My mom said no, but it was still a pleasure. We ate pizza instead and it tasted really good.

We went on a boating trip in February. It was cold but Captain Mike said it was safe. We were loading the big boat with food. I bought some candy and chips for the trip. 

"Stop moving so much," my sister grumbled at me. 

We sailed away from the ground and into the fog. Suddenly a huge monster drew near our boat! It looked like a giant stewed tomato with eyes. It was impossible to fight it. 

"Where is the guard?" I yelled loudly. 

The monster roared but we simply threw chips at it. The monster ate the chips and swam away. We sold the story to a newspaper later. My sister did not complain about me being brave after that.

One day my dog Buster got loose in the big field. He was running fast and jumping over the tall grass. I ran after him, screaming his name really loud. The scenery was nice but I was scared he was lost.

"Buster, come back!" I yelled.

He did not listen and he kept going through the mud. My brain was worried about failure. Then Buster appeared behind a big rock. He was dumping dirt everywhere and his pink tongue was out. I grasped his collar tight so he couldn't run again.

"You are a bad boy," I told him.

He just licked my hand and touched his nose to me. We walked home and I was bearing a big stick. The sun was going down and the shadows were growing long. My search was over and Buster was safe.

I was playing my new video game about jungle animals. It is an incredible game where you race a big elephant. I practiced training my runner every day after school. My mom brewed some hot cocoa and watched me play. She was reading the newspaper but kept looking up.

"You are getting better gradually," she said to me.

I ran straight ahead and jumped over a giant rock. Then my character did a bungee jump off a cliff! I was seeing the finish line coming up really fast. I pressed the blue button as hard as I could.

"I won!" I yelled really loud.

The elephant was slow and I was super fast today. I love this game so much.

I was exploring the big woods behind my house. My dog Buster was with me and he loves adventures. We walked for a long time and saw big trees surrounding us. Suddenly Buster started barking at a tall oak tree.

"What is it, Buster?" I called to him.

I looked up and saw a tiny cat clinging to a branch. The cat looked scared and was groaning quietly. It was in danger because it was stuck so high up. I knew I had to help it right away.

"Don't worry, kitty! I am coming!" I yelled loudly.

I carefully crossed the muddy creek to get closer. I climbed the bottom branches and grabbed the kitty. I was thrilled when I got down safe. Buster licked the kitty and his tail was loading up a wag. I took the cat home before getting a grounding for being late.

I was playing a huge soccer game on Saturday. My coach blew his silver whistle and the game started. We fought hard for the ball but the other team was fast. I grew tired because I was running so much. Although I was tired, I still ran fast to the goal.

"Pass it to me!" I screamed to my friend Sam.

Sam kicked it and I scorched the ball into the net. We won the game and we felt so happy. After the game, I was super hungry so my dad bought pizza.

"You crushed them," my dad said with a big smile.

I was bringing my trophy home when I tripped and crawled. My knee hurt but my dad taught me to be tough. I did not get pneumonia from the wet grass. I will write about my big win in school tomorrow.

I woke up and saw the sun was scorched hot. My dog Sparky ran to the door and sang a happy bark. We went outside to the plain field behind my house.

"Come here, Sparky!" I yelled loud.

Sparky sprinted fast and twisted in the green grass. He found a big stick and chewed it hard. Suddenly a rabbit appeared near the bushes. I was certain Sparky would chase it. But the rabbit disappeared into a hole.

"Where did it go?" I asked Sparky.

He just wagged his tail and looked happy to receive a pat. I knew he was the best dog ever. We walked home before my mom used scissors on my messy hair.

Me and my dog Buster went to the woods today. It looked like a green jungle with tall trees everywhere. Buster loves running and sniffing the dirt. Suddenly he stopped at a big pile of leaves. I saw something weird scattered on the ground. It was trash! Someone was dumping their garbage here.

"That is not honest," I told Buster. He barked at the trash.

We discovered an old bungee cord in the mess. It was bright blue and stretchy. We decided to clean it all up. Keeping nature clean is very important. I put the trash in a bag. Buster helped by wagging his tail.

When we got home, I heard a knock on my door. It was my mom.

"You are earning a big treat for this," she said.

Buster got a bone and I got ice cream. We saved the woods!

I was training for the big race at recess. My friend Sam was climbing on the jungle gym and watching me. I ran around the playground three times fast. My feet touched the ground hard every time I stepped.

"You look like you had too much caffeine!" Sam yelled.

"I am just super fast today," I shouted back.

Suddenly the bell started ringing very loud. Everyone started running to the door but I was still roaming around. I thought I could win one more race to the balcony. I ran past a kid eating roasted peanuts. I felt like a foreign car zooming by. I gradually slowed down when I saw the teacher.

"Good running, but time to go inside," she said.

I was out of breath but I felt like a winner.

It was raining really hard outside. Me and my best friend Sam wanted to explore the old shed. We ran inside and it smelled like old science experiments. Suddenly the door slammed shut and we were trapped! I tried to open it but my finger slipped.

"Push harder!" Sam yelled at me.

I pushed but there was a weird purple stain on the handle. Then we heard a loud ringing sound coming from a box.

"Is that a monster?" I asked.

Something fuzzy touched my shoe and I started screaming. We scrambled up onto a table. It was just a cat with its tongue sticking out! We laughed. The door finally opened and we ran back to my house. The cat followed us home.

One night I woke up because I heard a scary sound. It was like a moaning ghost outside my window. I grabbed my flashlight and I walked into the dark woods surrounding my house. I had a weird feeling in my tummy.

Suddenly I saw a blue light floating near a big fountain. It was a glowing jewel! I drew my toy sword and walked closer. A tiny white lamb jumped out.

"Don't be scared," the lamb spoke to me.

I picked up the jewel and felt a happy rhythm. Then I heard cheering from the trees. I can guarantee that was the best adventure ever!

Sam and I gripped our flashlights tight. We walked into the dark, weird cave.

"This is not on our schedule," Sam grumbled.

"Don't worry," I said. "We have to be brave."

My light bounced off the wet walls. Suddenly, we saw a giant dragon sleeping on a pile of gold! Its breath scorched the rock floor. It looked like it could gnaw on a car.

"We need to be honest," Sam whispered. "I am scared."

I counted to three and we ran fast. The dragon opened one eye but went back to sleep. We escaped its reign of terror! We ran all the way home and felt very safe.

I was walking in the woods and felt a breeze. Then I saw a green light behind a big tree. I was scared but I looked anyway. I found a tiny alien sitting on a rock. He had three eyes and big ears.

"Hello," I told him quietly.

He looked at me and held up his thumb. It was glowing bright purple! Then he pointed at a sign on his spaceship. The sign said 'Help Me' in red letters.

"I can help you squeeze inside," I said.

He screamed a happy noise and jumped in. The ship flew up fast. I waved goodbye to my new friend.

My brother Tom had a birthday sleepover last night. We ate pizza and chips and drank lots of soda. Tom started jumping on the bed and he looked crazy.

"Stop it right now!" my mom screamed from the hallway.

Tom didn't stop and he bounced way too high. Suddenly, the bed frame snapped and broke with a loud crack. Tom fell on the floor and started groaning and moaning.

"My leg hurts so bad!" he screeched loudly.

My dad ran in and said it was just too much caffeine. Mom said he needed more protein and less sugar next time. Then she said the scary word about grounding him for a week. My friends and I left the room fast. The party was over but at least nobody really got hurt.

I was dreaming about a huge blue robot on a mountain. Suddenly I woke up in my apartment and heard a noise. My neighbor plays his guitar too loud sometimes. But this sound was different and really weird.

I looked out the window and saw a spaceship land. A green alien walked out wearing a cool black leather jacket. He looked tired so he drank a cup of caffeine. I was scared but I counted to ten. The alien took out a pen and drew a picture.

"Do you like science?" the alien asked me loudly.

"Yes, but my nephew likes it more," I said back.

Then the alien lifted a car with zero weight. It was super cool and I want to go to space.

On Wednesday my nephew Tom and I went exploring outside. We wanted to play knights in the big woods. I had a stick for a sword and Tom had a chain. 

"I am a brave knight!" I yelled at a tree.

Tom grumbled because he was hungry and wanted a snack. We walked past our neighbor Mrs. Miller’s house. She greeted us with a smile and gave us apples. 

"You boys need company for your camping trip," she said.

Her dog Spot ran out and he had a collar like a jewel. Neither of us had seen such a shiny thing before. We obtained the apples and counted them all. There were enough for us and for Spot too. We sat on the grass and ate happily.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were so excited. My friends and I were roaming around the backyard in the dark. The grass on the ground was wet and cold.

"Look out, a monster is approaching!" shouted my friend Leo.

We all ran to the tent and tried to squeeze inside. It was freezing out there but warm in our sleeping bags. Then something funny happened. My dog Buster reached his paw through the zipper door. He wanted to be the king and reign over the tent.

"He thinks he is a person," I grinned at everyone.

We let him stay and ate chips all night long. It was the best birthday ever.

I was walking home when a green spaceship landed. It scorched the grass in my backyard and I was thrilled! A small alien with three eyes scrambled out. He looked lost and scared.

"Can you help me fix my ship?" he beeped loudly.

I nodded and grabbed my dad’s toolbox from the garage. We worked together on the engine until it grew bright purple. Suddenly, a big robot trapped us against the ship! It stomped on the ground and looked very mean.

"Watch out!" I yelled and threw a wrench at it.

The robot fell over and we escaped. It was the greatest day ever because I made an alien friend. Then he flew away into the stars.

One day me and my friend Sam went exploring. We woke up early and ran to the big meadow. The grass was tall and green. Suddenly we heard a loud noise. Something was stamping its feet hard on the ground.

"What is that big thing?" I screamed.

It was a huge bear and it looked angry! It started tearing up the dirt with its claws. We were so scared. I grabbed Sam’s arm and we started running. The bear was jumping over logs to catch us.

"We have to hide now!" Sam yelled.

We climbed a tree instead of running more. The bear tried to seize my foot but missed. We grinned when the bear finally walked away. We were lucky to not receive a bite. It was the scariest day ever.

Me and my dog Sparky were exploring in the woods. We were looking for science stuff like big bugs. Suddenly Sparky saw a squirrel and he bounced away.

"Come back Sparky!" I yelled at him.

He was roaming around near a big pile of leaves. I crawled under a bush to see what he found. It was a tiny kitten and she was trembling. Someone was dumping trash there and left her.

"Oh no," I thought. "She looks very scared."

Unfortunately it started raining and the kitten was moaning. I picked her up and put her in my jacket. We ran home stamping in the mud puddles. My mom let us keep her! Now Sparky has a new best friend.

My friends and I were playing a snowball fight outside. It was freezing cold, but we didn't care at all. We built a big fort to hide behind.

"Watch out for the danger!" yelled my friend Sam loudly.

I saw the other team roaming near the old tree. I quickly made a snowball and I threw it hard. It landed right on Sam’s big red hat. He looked funny and we laughed a lot. Then the wind blew very hard and scattered snow everywhere. Everyone scrambled to find cover behind the big bushes.

"My hands are trembling!" I shouted to Sam.

We pulled our gloves up and drank hot chocolate later. My mom roasted marshmallows for us inside the warm house. I felt like a little beetle in a rug. My ears were ringing but we won the big game.

We were playing kickball in the field. My heart was thumping hard because my team was leading. It was a pleasant day with a cool breeze. My neighbor Tim was up to kick next. He stamped his feet and looked ready.

"You can do it, Tim!" I yelled loudly.

Tim kicked the red ball high into the air. It flew past the old colonel who was reading a newspaper.

"Oh no, that is trouble!" Tim shouted.

We ran fast down the trail to find the ball. We neared the colonel's fence and looked around. I drew a map in the dirt to explain my plan. Just then, we heard cheering throughout the park. My friend Sarah found the ball near a bush. We won the big game!

I live in a tall apartment building near the park. One day, I went outside to the very beginning of the trail. I heard a loud whistle coming from a big tree. It was a blue bird singing a funny song.

"Look at that bird!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked up and squinted his eyes at the height. "I can't see him either," Sam said sadly.

Suddenly, the bird flew down near a pine needle on the ground. It looked like he was having a meeting with a squirrel. The squirrel chattered with anger because the bird stole his nut. It was a crazy scene to watch. I wished I had scissors to cut some grass for a bed for them. But we just watched them chase each other around the tree instead. Being outside is the best fun ever.

My cousin Sara came from a foreign country to visit us. She met my best friend Leo and we had a sleepover. We built a huge castle out of blankets in the living room. It was really good but the height was too tall. The whole thing shook and fell down on Leo’s head! We laughed a lot and then we got hungry. Mom brewed some hot cocoa for us to drink. Then I used a plastic knife to put peanut butter on bread.

"Don't spread it too thick," Sara said to me.

I made a mess but it tasted yummy. Before leaving, Sara gave me a shiny blue jewel. It is my favorite thing now.
